user_prompt: We need to adjust our production schedule due to a significant surge in Q2 demand forecasting and some critical supply constraints we're facing with our primary vendors. This will require coordinating engineering changes across our product lines, verifying compliance requirements, updating our procurement orders, and adjusting our workforce capacity planning. As part of this broader initiative, we'll also need to ensure our team members are compensated fairly for any overtime or shift changes resulting from the schedule adjustments, including updating any applicable merit considerations. Can you help us orchestrate all these moving pieces together, including the financial and compensation updates that will flow from these workforce adjustments?
